sources.title: Full list of Israeli high-tech layoffs in 2026 | CTech
sources.description: 26.10.26 SolarEdge to cut another 200 jobs as restructuring continues The Israeli solar technology company is set to cut dozens of positions locally in its fifth round of layoffs in less than three years 23.10.26 Fireblocks to lay off 7% of workforce amid Visa acquisition rumors The Israeli-founded digital asset security company is set to cut 60 to 70 jobs, including dozens in Israel, after rejecting reports that Visa is considering a $2.5 billion acquisition 13.10.26 XM Cyber lays off 250 of its 300 Israeli employees following $600 million CrowdStrike deal Calcalist has learned that only around 50 employees remain in Israel, working with existing customers, after extensive layoffs since CrowdStrike announced its acquisition of XM Cyber’s technology in July 12.10.26 Microsoft Israel cuts hit AI agent team, with 50 Copilot Studio employees summoned to pre-dismissal hearings The move is part of a global organizational shift affecting the Israeli R&D center. About half of the employees are expected to remain in roles within the center 8.10.26 HoneyBook lays off 14% of workforce in AI-driven restructuring The small-business software company is cutting 30 to 35 jobs, with the majority of the layoffs affecting employees in Israel, despite holding hundreds of millions of dollars in cash reserves 2.9.26 PayPal lays off dozens in Israel as it cuts 20% of global workforce The Israeli cuts are part of a worldwide restructuring launched under new CEO Enrique Lores. PayPal plans to eliminate about 4,760 jobs over two to three years as it seeks to simplify operations and save $1.5 billion annually IVIX lays off 10% of staff as it pivots toward AI financial investigator The company, which develops technology for governments fighting financial crime, is cutting roughly nine jobs while simultaneously hiring for new growth areas and expanding its AI product portfolio Bizzabo lays off dozens as Israeli event tech company restructures The company behind an event management platform used for physical, virtual and hybrid conferences says the changes are part of a transition to a faster way of working 24.8.26 After raising $51 million, Minimus shuts down as Twistlock founders return remaining cash to investors The cybersecurity startup failed to gain enough commercial momentum to continue operating. Customers will have 60 days to migrate before the company's registry is switched off SanDisk cuts dozens of jobs in Israel despite AI-fueled surge The memory-chip company is worth $230 billion after a 3,500% stock rally, but employees at its Israeli development centers have been laid off 23.8.26 Wi-Charge shuts down after 14 years trying to make wireless power a reality The Israeli company developed room-scale wireless energy transmission and sold its technology in dozens of countries, but struggled to overcome slow adoption, hardware costs and a persistent chicken-and-egg problem 17.8.26 Pentera lays off another 60 employees in second round of cuts in four months The latest cuts affect about 60 employees, including 30 in Israel, bringing the total number of layoffs since April to roughly 100, or 20% of Pentera’s workforce, even as the company continues hiring for AI-related positions 11.8.26 LinkedIn to shut down Israeli development center and lay off nearly all employees The center, which employs about 50 people, was established in 2022 following LinkedIn’s $80 million-$90 million acquisition of Israeli analytics startup Oribi 10.8.26 SciPlay cuts 20 jobs at its 300-person Israeli gaming hub The Israeli operation, built partly through the 2014 acquisition of Dragonplay, accounts for roughly one-third of SciPlay's global workforce and develops some of its biggest games 29.7.26 ServiceNow continues layoffs as it restructures around AI The enterprise software giant is cutting hundreds of jobs while increasing investment in artificial intelligence skills, saying it needs “the right talent in the right roles." 26.7.26 Papaya cuts 30 employees as Israeli gaming company restructures The company cites AI adoption, currency pressures and a changing technology environment as it adjusts its organizational structure 23.7.26 Moovit cuts 30% of workforce as Mobileye reshapes $915 million acquisition for robotaxi era The transportation app is eliminating 60 of its 200 positions as Mobileye shifts resources away from Moovit’s B2B business and toward using the platform for fleet supply, demand optimization and rider engagement in autonomous taxis 22.7.26 Monday.com cuts 20% of workforce as it restructures for the AI era The Israeli software company says it is replacing a structure built around managing work with one designed for AI agents and human collaboration, cutting about 630 jobs while redirecting resources toward its new strategy 21.7.26 WSC cuts 10% of workforce as AI sports startup restructures The sports-content automation company will lay off about 70 employees, most of them in Israel, as it adjusts to changing global market conditions 13.7.26 Israeli unicorn Redis cuts dozens of jobs despite $300 million revenue run rate The database company is reducing its Tel Aviv workforce by about 70 employees but says it remains committed to its Israeli development center 12.7.26 Alarum cuts workforce after FBI investigation rocks the company The Israeli company has begun laying off employees after U.S. authorities launched an investigation into subsidiary NetNut, triggering a sharp collapse in its share price 7.7.26 Legaltech startup Darrow lays off one-third of workforce despite profitability The Israeli company is cutting 60 jobs, including many legal analysts whose expertise helped build the AI platform that now powers its business 30.6.26 Former $450 million Israeli cyber exit Argus to shut down Now operating as PlaxidityX, the automotive cybersecurity company will close its Israeli operations and lay off its remaining 80 employees as parent Aumovio restructures amid a slowing automotive market 29.6.26 Elementor cuts 100 jobs, 30% of workforce, as AI reshapes website building Platform behind 25 million sites calls move a “reset” for the AI era 24.6.26 Cyberbit shuts down Israeli operations, lays off local workforce The former Elbit spin-off, which trains cybersecurity teams to defend against cyberattacks, is closing its local office and laying off all Israeli employees 16.6.26 Artlist to cut 200 jobs, 40% of workforce, in AI-driven overhaul Israeli creative-tech company says it is restructuring around an AI-native operating model despite rapid growth 8.6.26 Former unicorn Hailo cuts 50% of workforce amid funding pressure and strategic reset Israeli semiconductor company lays off 110 employees while shifting focus toward drones, robotics, and Physical AI 7.6.26 Zencity cuts staff in renewed efficiency push The Israeli-founded civic analytics company trims around 15-20 roles across product and engineering teams 3.6.26 Skai lays off 20% of staff, citing AI-driven transformation About 100 employees affected as company retools global operations model 2.6.26 Aleph Farms cuts jobs and shifts to outsourcing as cultivated meat industry stumbles Israeli foodtech company seeks fresh funding while adapting to a market struggling to prove commercial viability 1.6.26 Lightricks to split into two companies as it cuts another 75 jobs Jerusalem unicorn reshapes itself around AI, as Facetune profitability funds a costly push into video models 28.5.26 “We are restructuring Rapyd”: fintech unicorn begins layoffs amid AI shift CEO says company is building a “unified, AI-driven organization” to scale and grow profitably Minute Media lays off 12% of workforce, reverses course on VideoVerse after $200 million acquisition The unicorn says restructuring reflects push for efficiency and long-term growth amid changes in the media market and rising AI-driven disruption, alongside termination of VideoVerse integration Amdocs prepares major layoffs as new CEO launches sweeping reorganization Software giant expected to cut up to 10% of workforce, including hundreds in Israel Cyber firm SentinelOne set to lay off hundreds of employees Wall Street-listed company expected to announce cuts alongside earnings report 27.5.26 Lightricks preparing new layoffs as AI reshapes company structure Jerusalem-based unicorn expected to cut dozens of jobs amid organizational overhaul PayPal plans layoffs in Israel amid wider restructuring effort Local development center employs hundreds of engineers and data scientists 26.5.26 Data security unicorn BigID cuts 20% of workforce in shift to AI-first strategy Company says restructuring supports transition to AI-centric development model 25.5.26 Wix to cut 1,000 jobs in largest layoff round in company history The company will reduce roughly 20% of its workforce after a steep stock decline and rising AI-related costs 21.5.26 Intuit layoffs reach Israel as AI push reshapes global workforce The financial software giant is cutting 3,000 jobs worldwide, with its 500-person Israeli R&D center also affected amid a broader restructuring around artificial intelligence 18.5.26 AI21 cuts more than 60% of its workforce in major strategic overhaul The Israeli AI company will focus exclusively on AI agent optimization technology built around Maestro after Nebius acquisition talks collapse AI infrastructure firm SQream enters insolvency process as losses top $100 million Court filing details debts across wages, taxes, rent, and royalties 11.5.26 ZoomInfo to shut Israel R&D center, lay off 300 employees The closure comes five years after the US software company acquired Israeli startup Chorus.ai for $575 million 21.4.26 After raising $124 million, Sight Diagnostics on brink of closure after laying off all employees Board moves to cut final employees as company struggles to continue 16.4.26 Printing giant Shutterfly to shut Israel operations, lay off 80 employees Haifa-based center to close as company restructures global operations 15.4.26 Taboola lays off 100 employees amid shift toward AI products The company continues hiring as it accelerates DeeperDive expansion with major media partners Nayax cuts 3% of workforce in second round of layoffs in 10 months The fintech company will lay off 32 employees, including 20 in Israel, as part of ongoing efficiency measures, despite reporting strong revenue growth, a return to profitability in 2025, and expectations to surpass $500 million in revenue this year 13.4.26 Blockchain unicorn StarkWare cuts dozens of jobs in strategic shift The Israeli firm said it has “begun a process of reducing its workforce and shifting its focus from infrastructure and research to revenue-generating products.” 12.4.26 Nir Zuk’s Esh Group cuts staff following Isracard transaction Dozens laid off as company adapts to post-sale reality 4.3.26 Insurtech unicorn At-Bay lays off 25 R&D staff in Israel amid profit push Cyber insurance company is restructuring its development division as it shifts toward operating profitability 2.3.26 After $2 billion buyout, Verint lays off hundreds as private equity era begins Job cuts follow Thoma Bravo’s acquisition and leadership overhaul as the company integrates with Calabrio 20.2.26 Unicorn Firebolt slashes workforce as AI reshapes operations Data warehouse company cuts dozens despite holding more than $100m in cash 15.2.26 Axonius cuts 40 employees as CEO steps down Layoffs and leadership change come amid IPO plans and reported acquisition talks Huawei’s Israeli R&D center cuts 12% of cloud employees Layoffs affect around 50 of Toga Networks’ local workforce 12.2.26 Palo Alto Networks lays off hundreds of CyberArk employees one day after completing $25 billion acquisition Cuts affect both Israeli and global staff as the company says overlaps between teams prompted strategic organizational changes, while pledging continued investment in technology and business continuity 4.2.26 Remitly cuts 110 jobs in Israel and closes R&D hub three years after $80 million Rewire acquisition Seattle fintech to retain only sales and business roles locally after Zoom-delivered layoffs affecting more than half of Israeli workforce 27.1.26 Gaming unicorn Moon Active cuts 5% of workforce as it reshapes operations Layoffs affect roughly 110 employees of the Coin Master developer 20.1.26 Vimeo begins winding down its Israeli operations after broad layoffs The video platform is dismantling a development center built through over $200 million in acquisitions 14.1.26 Playtika to lay off about 500 employees in 15% workforce cut CEO Robert Antokol cites need to “right-size” the organization 13.1.26 eToro to lay off 7% of workforce 105 jobs to be cut less than a year after the company’s Wall Street debut StoreDot lays off dozens as it prepares for $800 million SPAC merger Fast-charging battery developer pares workforce ahead of Nasdaq listing 12.1.26 Sapiens begins global layoffs as new owner Advent reshapes the company Sapiens is embarking on a broad restructuring that will include layoffs of approximately 10% of its global workforce, or about 540 employees out of a total of 5,400 8.1.26 AI chip unicorn Hailo to lay off nearly 10% of staff as it refocuses on robotics and Physical AI Cuts come as the $344 million-funded startup prepares a new, significant fundraising round Foretellix lays off about 18% of its workforce as AI adoption reshapes operations The autonomous-vehicle software company said the cuts affect 29 employees and follow a period of growth, new commercial deals, and wider use of AI tools
